name: Observation Quest
description: Place-based hidden-object games that build visual scanning, comparison, and attention.
author: Koda Learning Lab
tagline: Look closely, scan the scene, and spot every match.

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Uses AI-generated voice recordings for directions, hints, object names, and celebrations.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays pop, success, and not-match feedback sounds.

features.name: Haptic feedback
features.description: Pairs correct and incorrect taps with device feedback.

features.name: Target previews
features.description: Shows the object or silhouette the learner must find.

features.name: Search-region hints
features.description: Guides attention toward a broad quadrant without revealing the answer.

features.name: Labelled list view
features.description: Offers a labelled, keyboard-friendly card list as an alternative to searching the scene.

features.name: Step framing tags
features.description: Labels warm-up, challenge, and milestone steps.

features.name: Charge for later lessons
features.description: Keeps a configurable number of lessons free.

settingsSchema.label: Final tag
settingsSchema.help: Optional wording for the final step.

settingsSchema.label: Free lessons
settingsSchema.help: Number of lessons available before a plan is needed.
